enabledComponents.comment_components: Toggle individual deployment steps on/off. 'infrastructure' controls Kafka Docker/topic setup. 'pipelines' imports the declarative QTCP pipeline project (Step 13).

infrastructure.comment_useDocker: true = start Confluent Kafka via Docker Compose (infrastructure/kafka/). false = create topics on external broker using bootstrapServers from dataConnections.kafka.
infrastructure.comment_simulatorInterval: Seconds between Kafka IoT simulator batches when using --scheduled mode (default 900 = 15 min)

kafka.name: MCG IoT Telemetry
kafka.comment_bootstrapServers: Use localhost:9092 for Docker Compose, or your-broker:9092 for Confluent Cloud / MSK / self-managed
kafka.comment_topics: Two Kafka topics: cold-chain (sensor readings ~1msg/5s) and carrier-events (status updates ~1msg/min)
kafka.comment_securityProtocol: Use PLAINTEXT for Docker Compose local dev, SASL_SSL for Confluent Cloud / production

lakehouse.name: MCG Demo Lakehouse
lakehouse.comment_storage: Use 'qlik-managed' or provide S3/Azure Blob/GCS connection details

cdc.name: CDC Cluster
cdc.comment: Handles PostgreSQL change data capture (Pipelines 1-3) and Salesforce incremental sync (Pipelines 6-8)

streaming.name: Streaming Cluster
streaming.comment: Handles real-time Kafka ingestion from IoT topics mcg.iot.cold-chain and mcg.iot.carrier-events (Pipelines 4-5)

theme.name: MCG Dark Theme
theme.comment_theme: Upload via Administration → Themes. Contains theme.json, .qext manifest, MCG logos. Colors: Navy #1B2A4A, Teal #0D7C8F, Gold #C4922E, Inter font.

knowledgeBase.name: MCG Operations Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.description: Operational documents for Meridian Commerce Group — SOPs, policies, incident reports, contracts, and project documentation.

assistant.name: MCG Operations Assistant
assistant.description: AI assistant for Meridian Commerce Group operations. Ask about procedures, incidents, policies, carrier contracts, and Project CLARITY.
conversationStarters: What is the procedure for goods receiving?
What happened during the Rotterdam pipeline failure?
What are the cold chain temperature requirements?
What was the lettuce recall and what went wrong?

dataProducts.comment_sourceFile: JSON file with Gold-layer data product definitions (7 products). Loaded automatically by deploy script.

glossary.comment_sourceFile: JSON file with 25 business glossary terms. Loaded automatically by deploy script.

pipelines.comment_pipelines: Declarative QTCP pipeline project (YAML) imported via the DI Projects API (preview). Bindings for connections/schemas/clusters are resolved automatically from this config; 'bindings' holds exact-key overrides. databaseName defaults to the lakehouse name. Set prepare=true to validate+prepare tasks right after import; run=true additionally starts tasks in dependency order (landing>transform>datamart). attachDatasets resolves gold catalog datasets and attaches them to the matching data products (JSON-Patch /datasetIds); publishDataProducts activates them in the marketplace. Daily schedules live in the YAML (qtcp_tasks/*/schedule.yaml). Round-trip UI edits back to the repo with: npm run deploy:export-pipeline

automations.comment_templateDir: Directory containing automation JSON templates (Teams alerts, pipeline health). Loaded automatically.
automations.comment_teamsWebhookUrl: Microsoft Teams incoming webhook URL for alert automations

documents.comment_sourceDir: Relative path from the deploy/ directory to the documents folder containing .docx files

apps.comment_sourceDir: Place .qvf app export files in this directory before running deploy

mcp.comment_mcp: Qlik MCP Server is cloud-hosted (SSE endpoint) — no local install required. Add this to Claude Desktop/Code config.

options.comment_options: dryRun=true will log actions without executing. continueOnError=true skips failed steps.
